Coil wound: 9 turn(s), 4 section(s).
  primary section 0: conduction, primary, 1 layer(s), 6 turn(s), filling factor 0.0901
  Insulation between primary and secondary section 1: insulation, 1 layer(s), 0 turn(s), filling factor 1
  secondary section 0: conduction, secondary, 1 layer(s), 3 turn(s), filling factor 0.045
  Insulation between secondary and primary section 3: insulation, 1 layer(s), 0 turn(s), filling factor 1
The widget shows MKF's Painter cross-section.
